_comment: Supply-chain pins for every checkpoint this repo downloads.
WHY: create_model_and_transforms() fetches ~1.6 GB from a public registry and
loads it. Unpinned, the integrity story is 'HTTPS, and trust the registry' --
the same trust model that put a trojan on this machine in March 2026 via a
poisoned VS Code extension. A pin turns 'the upstream changed' from something
you never notice into a loud stop.
HOW TO ADD A MODEL: run the exporter with --allow-unpinned. It downloads,
prints the revision and per-file sha256, and refuses to proceed. Paste the
block it prints here, then re-run without the flag.
sha256 values are of the file contents. HuggingFace names LFS blobs by their
own sha256, so a cached blob's filename can be checked against these directly.
